newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 70.9 bln dmk in repos, adds funds.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 70.9 bln dmk in repos, adds funds.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Wednesday it has allocated 70.9 billion marks of securities repurchase funds at this week's tender at a fixed rate of 3.0 percent.
The German central bank accepted 28.9 percent of the bids made for the 14-day funds.
A repo pact for 69.6 billion marks at a fixed 3.0 percent rate expires on Wednesday, so a net 1.3 billion marks is flowing into the market.
The Bundesbank said banks bid for 245.5 billion marks of the repurchase funds this week.
